proposals.citation: brightbill-turner2007dogri[Appendix B, printed p. 27, item 71, Batote];CDIAL[4749]
proposals.evidence: The original SIL-font response is t͡ʃɔl rice (cooked), and Turner 4749 gives Punjabi caul and West Pahari cau under *cāmala/*cāvala rice. The source specifies cooked rice, a narrower local usage than the dictionary’s husked-rice headword; its gloss is preserved.
